◈ THE WAR PATH — Footage plays. The galaxy has already watched these fights twice. The System narrates anyway — it likes the sound of its own broadcast voice. THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Eulogy and lived to sit here. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. 1 more of the later drafts faced besides.
